Interface AdvancementTree

All Superinterfaces:
AdvancementNode, Keyed, ResourceKeyed
public interface AdvancementTree extends AdvancementNode
Represents a Advancement tree or tab menu. The tree will become visible to a Player once the root advancement gets achieved.
